company.name: Cognna
company.shortDescription: Cognna provides cybersecurity stress-free, by providing the tools needed to detect, prevent, and resolve threats with ease.
company.description: COGNNA is a SaaS cybersecurity company focused on leveraging cognitive technology to enhance security operations, providing innovative solutions for proactive threat detection, anomaly identification, and adaptive risk management. Our mission is to simplify complex forensic analysis and empower security analysts with intelligence insights for comprehensive threat understanding.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven security operations platform that autonomously detects, analyzes, and responds to cyber threats in real-time to reduce alert fatigue and accelerate incident response.
productsAndServices.name: COGNNA Nexus Agentic AI SOC Platform

productsAndServices.description: A 24/7 managed security service that provides continuous threat detection, incident response, and vulnerability assessment to protect organizations from cyberattacks.
productsAndServices.name: Managed Detection and Response (MDR) Services

productsAndServices.description: A service that automatically identifies IT assets, uncovers shadow IT, detects visibility gaps, and performs vulnerability scanning to enhance security posture.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Asset Discovery and Vulnerability Management

productsAndServices.description: A platform feature that enriches security data with internal and external threat intelligence using cognitive analytics to improve threat validation and reduce false positives.
productsAndServices.name: Threat Intelligence Integration and Cognitive Analytics

productsAndServices.description: A real-time assessment tool that evaluates an organization's security posture and provides tailored insights and recommendations.
productsAndServices.name: COGNNA Risk Score

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $11,064,364 to $45,867,661, a 4.15x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
